steps.text: HCl used $=0.1\times40=4$ mmol. $\ce{Ca(OH)2 + 2HCl -> CaCl2 + 2H2O}$, so excess $\ce{Ca(OH)2}=2$ mmol.

At STP-like conditions ($1$ atm, $273$ K) 1 mol occupies $22.4$ L, so $x=2\times10^{-3}\times22400=44.8\approx45$ cm$^3$.

pitfalls: Using the 4 mmol of HCl as moles of $\ce{Ca(OH)2}$.
